headline: DOJ Watchdog Opens Review of DEA Tactic That Let Fentanyl Shipments Keep Moving
summary: The Justice Department inspector general has opened a review of DEA policies and wiretap investigations after an Associated Press investigation found agents in New Mexico monitored major fentanyl deliveries without seizing them while pursuing larger trafficking cases. AP reported one 2023 delivery involved 74,000 pills. DEA Administrator Terrance Cole, who requested independent OIG review in June, said the request did not reflect a lack of confidence in DEA personnel or the investigative decisions at issue.
fml_kicker: One Pill Can Kill. The watchdog now gets to ask why 74,000 were allowed to keep moving.
